title: Which AI Writes the Best Resume? ChatGPT vs Google Gemini vs Claude Resume
description:
In this video, a recruiter tests various AI (ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Claude) to see which one can write the best resume. We compare resumes generated by ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Claude AI in common scenarios, including writing a resume from scratch and updating a resume. By the end, you'll know which AI you should use for your resume. 

#resumewriting #airesume #resumetips 

Writing a resume from scratch: 01:00
Updating a resume: 13:24
